messages:
mike-sales: Quick help: OrchidPay POC failing on rerank stage. They get a dimension mismatch and occasional 429s during bulk upload. Can we triage?

anya-ml: paste error + which embed model they call.

mike-sales: logs: 
```
ValueError: vector length mismatch (expected 1024, got 1536)
POST /v1/embeddings -> 200 (model=embed-sim-1536)
/compare -> 400 {"error":"dimension mismatch"}
```

rob-eng: likely their index was built with 1024d vectors and their pipeline now returns 1536. 429s mean their batch/concurrency is too high.

gina-se: quickest unblock: pin model in SDK to the legacy 1024 model for the POC. Longer term: re-index with 1536.

support-bot: rate_limit: 429 on /v1/embeddings/bulk; X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0; reset_in: 42s

anya-ml: ask them to run one embedding call and show .model and embedding length. curl example:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"embed-sim-1536","input":["hi"]}' | jq .
```

mike-sales: customer ran it -> model: "embed-sim-1536", embedding length 1536. They pinned model to "embed-base-1024" in SDK and that fixed the compare error.

gina-se: for 429s recommend batch_size=16, concurrency<=4 and exponential backoff. If they want a smooth POC, support can authorize a temporary 48h quota bump (send customer name + target qps).

mike-sales: sending details to support now. Customer will pin for POC and schedule re-index later. Thanks :thumbsup:
